query: ALTER TABLE container_registry_repository_tag ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_repository_tag_chk_name CHECK(name ~ '[a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,127}'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_repository_tag_fk_repository_id FOREIGN KEY(repository_id) REFERENCES container_registry_repository(id), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_repository_tag_fk_manifest_digest FOREIGN KEY(manifest_digest) REFERENCES container_registry_manifest(digest);
